components.role_description: length of the binary string for each test case
substring size for each test case
binary string S for each test case

constraints.name: binary_character_set
constraints.description: 字符串 S 仅由字符 '0' 和 '1' 组成

constraints.name: substring_contiguous
constraints.description: 子串必须是原字符串的连续部分
constraints.formal: A substring is a contiguous segment of S

constraints.name: substring_fixed_length
constraints.description: 所有被考虑的子串长度必须恰好为 K

constraints.name: exhaustive_substrings
constraints.description: 必须取 S 中所有长度恰好为 K 的子串进行异或操作
constraints.formal: T = XOR of all S[i..i+K-1] for i from 0 to N-K

objective.description: Compute the number of 1 bits in the XOR of all length-K substrings of a binary string

invariants.name: prefix_sum_parity_relation
invariants.description: The algorithm maintains that the parity (mod 2) of the number of 1s in any interval [i, i+N-K] equals the difference of prefix sums modulo 2, and the variable r correctly holds the prefix sum up to i-1, ensuring s[i] captures the XOR result for the i-th position of T.
